ac1c0742cd847d32e66ce8cfc5a6217a.overview: Set during the Cold War, the Soviets—led by sword-wielding Irina Spalko—are in search of a crystal skull which has supernatural powers related to a mystical Lost City of Gold. Indy is coerced to head to Peru at the behest of a young man whose friend—and Indy's colleague—Professor Oxley has been captured for his knowledge of the skull's whereabouts.

ac429b887019430037e0a1d9c6f6fb74.overview: During the Boer War, three Australian lieutenants are on trial for shooting Boer prisoners. Though they acted under orders, they are being used as scapegoats by the General Staff, who hopes to distance themselves from the irregular practices of the war. The trial does not progress as smoothly as expected by the General Staff, as the defence puts up a strong fight in the courtroom.
ac429b887019430037e0a1d9c6f6fb74.tagline: A powerful true story of bitter revenge...

ac5de855468d2e76b9dfb3e87b2adc43.overview: An ambitious reporter gets in trouble while investigating a senator's assassination which leads to a vast conspiracy involving a multinational corporation behind every event in the world's headlines.

ac98140c386f473bc6d19ce2a5dae83a.overview: The story of Gary Valentine and Alana Kane growing up, running around and going through the treacherous navigation of first love in the San Fernando Valley, 1973.

ac98c2cb5f73e0fe6b27d40f93c66e87.overview: On her way home from a stay at a mental institution after a traumatic rape, a woman realizes that someone is deliberately trying to drive her insane.
ac98c2cb5f73e0fe6b27d40f93c66e87.tagline: What happened to little Susan was so horrible, she's been away for seven years. Now she's back...and so is the horror.

ace0c35b4fb1195ed577dfa301d2b66d.overview: Joe Buck is a wide-eyed hustler from Texas hoping to score big with wealthy New York City women; he finds a companion in Enrico "Ratso" Rizzo, an ailing swindler with a bum leg and a quixotic fantasy of escaping to Florida.
ace0c35b4fb1195ed577dfa301d2b66d.tagline: For those who have never seen it and those who have never forgotten it.
